pages.name: Who Owes Me
pages.description: Home dashboard listing overdue clients with exact amounts and days overdue, plus clear action alerts.

uses.Solo Freelance Makeup Artist: scan overdue clients, act on alerts like chasing a balance before rent, copy reminders

pages.name: Invoices
pages.description: List of all invoices showing client, event date, total fee, advance paid and pending balance.

uses.Solo Freelance Makeup Artist: track pending balances, open invoices, mark payments received

pages.name: Invoice Detail
pages.description: Shows one invoice's fee, advance and balance, and lets the artist mark payments received and copy a payment reminder.

uses.Solo Freelance Makeup Artist: record a payment received, copy a one-click WhatsApp reminder

pages.name: New Invoice
pages.description: Form to create an invoice in three taps with client name, event date, total fee and advance paid.

uses.Solo Freelance Makeup Artist: enter client name, event date, total fee and advance paid

pages.name: Cash Forecast
pages.description: 30, 60 and 90 day chart comparing expected client inflows against upcoming bills, with a what-if toggle for a late bridal payment.

uses.Solo Freelance Makeup Artist: review 30/60/90 day cash and switch the late bridal payment what-if on or off

pages.name: Bills
pages.description: List of upcoming bills such as rent and cosmetic restocks with their due dates and amounts.

uses.Solo Freelance Makeup Artist: review upcoming rent and restock costs

pages.name: New Bill
pages.description: Form to add an upcoming bill such as rent or a cosmetic restock with its amount and due date.

uses.Solo Freelance Makeup Artist: enter bill name, amount and due date
